import sys

def main():
    lines = [line.rstrip('\n') for line in sys.stdin]
    if not lines:
        return

    idx = 0
    n = int(lines[idx])
    idx += 1

    books = []
    for _ in range(n):
        title = lines[idx]
        author = lines[idx + 1]
        date = lines[idx + 2]
        idx += 3
        books.append((title, author, date))

    q = int(lines[idx])
    idx += 1

    out = []

    for qi in range(q):
        parts = lines[idx].split()
        idx += 1

        q_title, q_author, q_from, q_to = parts

        matched = []
        for title, author, date in books:
            if q_title != '*' and q_title not in title:
                continue
            if q_author != '*' and q_author not in author:
                continue
            if q_from != '*' and date < q_from:
                continue
            if q_to != '*' and date > q_to:
                continue
            matched.append(title)

        out.extend(matched)
        if qi != q - 1:
            out.append("")

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
